title: Assemblies, attributes, reflection — concept map
intro: Go past Intermediate Language (IL) in a dynamic-link library (DLL). This module covers assemblies and metadata, attributes the compiler and frameworks honor, reflection costs and alternatives, source generators for compile-time code, and continuous integration (CI) guards on public API surface.

overviewDiagram.title: Metadata to code paths
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  A[C# source] --> B[Roslyn compile]
  B --> C[Assembly IL plus metadata]
  C --> D[Reflection runtime]
  C --> E[Source generators compile time]
  C --> F[Frameworks read attributes]
  G[CI public API diff] --> C

conceptCards.title: Assemblies
conceptCards.summary: Versioned IL plus metadata. ALC for plugins. InternalsVisibleTo for test friends.

conceptCards.title: Attributes
conceptCards.summary: Metadata on types and members. Validation, JSON names, Obsolete. Compiler honors a small set.

conceptCards.title: Reflection
conceptCards.summary: Runtime type inspection and invoke. OK at startup; avoid per-request hot paths.

conceptCards.title: Source generators
conceptCards.summary: Emit C# during build. DynamicallyAccessedMembers for trim-safe reflection. AOT friendly.

conceptCards.title: Public API CI
conceptCards.summary: Diff exported surface in pull requests. Default internal. Major bump for breaks.
